artworks.title: Labor and Diligence Enjoying their Simple Meal
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene with allegorical figures. Various figures are depicted around a table, each labeled with symbolic names such as Labor and Diligentia. An angelic figure hovers above the table, presenting a laurel wreath and other symbolic items. The surroundings feature draped curtains, classical architecture with columns, and mountains in the background. Each figure holds objects such as plates, a jug, or an hourglass, contributing to the scene's symbolic narrative. The composition suggests themes of virtue, diligence, and moderation.

artworks.title: The Diligent Worker United with Christ after Death
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of religious figures near a cross. A central figure is bound to a wooden cross, flanked by two other figures in a religious scene symbolizing themes of faith and redemption. One figure kneels while another holds a cloak, gesturing towards the central figure. Surrounding them are symbolic objects, including a skull, a putto, and nautical elements with a coastal landscape in the background. The sky has dramatic clouds and rays of light above the cross. Latin inscriptions are included in the lower part of the composition.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page with classical figures surrounding a Latin inscription. The central focus is on an elaborate rectangular frame containing the title "ACTA APOSTOLORUM" and additional Latin text noting the creators and publishers of the book. Surrounding the frame are depictions of classical or biblical figures, seated or standing, engaged in various activities such as reading or holding scrolls and books. These figures are placed in niches or on platforms, framed by decorative columns. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings, marked by meticulous detail and balanced composition.

artworks.title: The Meeting of the Apostles and the Women in the Upper Room
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals inside a dimly lit room. The scene shows them wearing robes and gathered together. The central figure is gesturing with a hand near the chest. Other figures are either sitting or standing, with some in contemplative poses. The room has intricate architectural elements like columns, a checkerboard-patterned floor, and curtains. There are objects on a mantelpiece and a jug on the floor. The artwork is detailed with shading and fine line work.

artworks.title: The Choosing of Saint Matthias
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a multi-scene architectural composition with figures engaged in various activities. The image is divided into different sections depicting several interactions. In the upper section, a figure addresses a group of seated individuals in an enclosed space. This area is detailed with architectural elements like columns and an ornate ceiling. Below, other figures converse near an entrance supported by columns, leading to a staircase that descends with figures further below. The background shows architectural cityscape views, with additional figures engaged in different activities. Complex lines and shading are used to depict depth and dimension to the structures and characters in the drawing.

artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed figures gathered indoors, with light streaming down from above. The image shows an intricate scene within an architectural interior where numerous figures are engaged in a moment of reverence. Some figures are on their knees, and others stand or sit, all with expressions suggesting admiration or devotion as they behold a radiant figure or light descending from above. The light, symbolized by rays, seems to emanate from a dove. A sense of movement is portrayed by the figures with raised hands and the heavenly beings amongst the clouds above. The style of the drawing is detailed and linear, giving it a formal and historic atmosphere. The scene conveys serenity and sacredness, set against a backdrop with architectural details that enhance the solemnity of the moment depicted.

artworks.title: Saint Peter Speaks to the People about Christ
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate scene on a set of stairs with architectural surroundings. The scene is meticulously detailed with various figures positioned on and around a large staircase. The primary action seems to be centered on the upper terrace, where a bearded figure is standing at the top of a stairway, gesturing outward. Multiple figures surround him, some sitting and others standing, with expressions that convey a sense of listening or reacting to the central figure. Below, other figures gather, many of whom appear to be seated or standing in poses of discussion or contemplation, while some show surprise or disbelief. There are architectural elements such as a wall with pilasters in the background, and a domed structure to the right that evokes a building of significant size or importance. In the distance, a landscape with a cityscape featuring towers and spires is visible, enhancing the scene with depth and perspective. The use of line and shading is precise, capturing details in clothing, expressions, and the overall composition.

artworks.title: Many are Baptized
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious baptismal scene. The artwork depicts figures engaged in a baptism ritual. Some figures are kneeling, while others are standing. The central figure appears to be dispensing a blessing or participating in the act of baptism. Surrounding this central activity are architectural elements, with arches, columns, and drapery. In the background, there are additional figures and a building interior. The drawing uses expressive lines and detailed engraving to convey texture, clothing, and emotion within the scene.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and John Heal a Cripple at the Gate of the Temple
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set in a classical architectural setting. The art depicts an interaction between several figures within a series of arches and columns. The background architecture features large arches and columns typical of classical design, while the foreground contains people in various poses. The attention to detail in the clothing and expressions indicates a detailed narrative moment. The image illustrates themes of antiquity and storytelling through the physical expressions and interplay of figures against the architectural backdrop.

artworks.title: And They were All Filled with the Holy Ghost
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of an interior scene with a two-level narrative. The upper portion shows a group of figures on a balcony under a wooden ceiling, illuminated by a sun-like light. Some figures are seated while others stand, with dynamic clothing suggesting movement.

In the lower part, there is a room with a table, two figures, an open book, and other objects. One figure leads another by the hand. An architectural feature, possibly an altar, and a classical statue are also present. The scene is detailed with cross-hatching and line work, creating depth and texture without showing any conjecture.

artworks.title: The Deaths of Ananias and Sapphira
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The composition is divided into two main areas: on the right, a group of figures with halos stand on steps, one central figure appears to be addressing the others. On the ground between them lies another figure, surrounded by coins and possessions. On the left, a different group of figures appears to be engaging in conversation or transactions. In the background, Romanesque architecture is depicted. The figures are detailed with intricate line work, adding drama and narrative to the piece.

artworks.title: Saint Peter Healing the Sick with His Shadow
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a classical architectural setting. The image shows figures in various poses amidst buildings and columns. In the center, a figure holds keys. The background features architectural details. The composition is detailed, showcasing an interplay of figures and architecture.

artworks.title: The Apostles Delivered from Prison by an Angel
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures being led by an angel out of an architectural structure. The figures wear classical robes and have halos above their heads. The angel prominently displays wings and gestures with a guiding hand as several other figures follow. The background shows a grand architectural setting with columns and arches. The stone texture and crosshatching illustrate the depth and grandeur of the scene. On either side of the staircase, further figures are present, some seemingly asleep or in a state of repose wearing armor. The image includes text in Latin beneath the scene. This drawing employs careful lines and shading to create depth and texture typical of classical printmaking techniques.

artworks.title: Saint Stephen before the Council
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple full-body figures within an architectural setting. On the left, an elderly man is seated on an elevated platform, possibly a throne, dressed in elaborate robes and a bishop's miter. In front of him, figures stand, including another bearded man who seems to be speaking. Other men in robes, some with wreaths on their heads, and armored soldiers with plumed helmets and spears stand nearby on the right. Pillars surround the scene, and through an archway in the background, a tower and distant landscape are visible. In a smaller panel to the right, a hillside scene with people and a city in the background is illustrated, with a dog lying on the steps in the foreground. The illustration is detailed and depicts a narrative within an architectural framework.

artworks.title: Devout Men Carrying Saint Stephen to His Burial
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene under a classical architectural setting. The image features a group of figures gathered in the foreground around a central event. The scene includes a grand colonnaded structure with detailed textures and expressive figures engaging in various actions. In the background, there are more figures and buildings with domes and spires, suggesting an urban environment. The drawing is rendered in a monochrome palette, emphasizing line work and contrast.

artworks.title: The People of Samaria Receive the Word of God
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a biblical scene. Multiple figures are surrounding two central figures. In the foreground, the central figures with halos are engaged in a religious ritual with a group of kneeling and seated characters. The background shows an architectural setting with columns, steps, and figures in various poses. Rays of light shine down above the central figures. The drawing is detailed, focusing on the expressions and gestures of each figure, conveying a moment of reverence and spiritual significance.

artworks.title: The Angel Orders Saint Philip to Accompany the Ethiopian Eunuch
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel visiting a figure indoors. The angel, with wings and robes, reaches out towards a haloed figure. The room contains a table with books and a candlestick, along with a large book on the ground. Through a window, an outdoor scene is visible showing a road with a chariot, a castle, and a tree. The drawing is detailed and resembles engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Baptism of the Eunuch by Saint Philip
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene beside a river. The image depicts a riverbank where a figure is kneeling, and another is standing near them. A two-horse-drawn chariot carrying two figures is shown beside them. The background features a bridge crossing the river and a settlement with buildings and a tower or castle structure, set against a mountainous landscape. In the sky, angelic figures are illustrated above the scene. The drawing is intricately composed, capturing various actions within a narrative context.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with soldiers and horses in a chaotic setting. The central figure is a soldier or warrior with a spear, surrounded by other figures in different actions. The scene includes armored individuals, charging horses, and a backdrop of a fortified city or settlement. The detailed line work suggests a classical or historical setting, with themes of war and conquest. Architectural elements like fortified walls and rocky landscapes add depth to the scene, highlighting the tumultuous events.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Escapes from Damascus
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image shows a figure running and looking upwards to the right. The person has curly hair and a curly beard, dressed in flowing garments and appears to be barefoot. They hold a staff in one hand and something under their other arm. In the background, two figures lean over a large stone structure, lowering another person in a basket. The scene is set in a city with arches and buildings visible under a starry night sky with a crescent moon.

artworks.title: The Healing of Eneas by Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image depicts three main figures in the foreground. To the right, a bearded man with curly hair is partially dressed, sitting up from a reclined position. He is twisting his torso, resting one hand on the cloth-covered bed and the other on his head, looking towards the other two figures. The central figure is a man with a short beard and curly hair, wearing a long robe and gesturing with his hands as he stands facing the seated man. To their left, a woman with her hair covered appears to be in motion, holding the edges of her robe, her facial features obscured by shadows. A small dog is lying on the ground beside the bed. The interior setting includes a large fireplace or hearth in the center, with various pots and pans hanging on the walls. To the left, a person is shown drawing water from a well beneath a balcony. The background shows architectural elements such as buildings and archways, with additional figures visible through doorways and the open courtyard area. Various household items and tools hang along the walls.

artworks.title: The Raising of Tabitha
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a narrative scene with three primary segments. The left section shows an architectural backdrop with columns, an archway, a figure walking outside, and two robed figures conversing on a staircase indoors. The middle segment shows multiple robed individuals around a reclining figure with a sense of urgency and religious symbolism. The right segment depicts three figures in an interior scene that looks like a baptismal or ceremonial practice. The drawing is detailed with careful linework and composition.

artworks.title: The Angel Commands Cornelius to Fetch Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Biblical scene with a soldier, a philosopher, and a celestial being. The central figure, dressed in Roman attire, is under angelic visitation in a classical architectural setting. In the foreground, a heavily armored Roman centurion converses with another figure, both against a backdrop of steps leading to a bustling urban scene. To the right, a venerable bearded man sits on an ornate chair, seemingly engaged in an interaction with an ethereal angelic figure. Above and to the right, another angelic figure emerges from the clouds. The illustration is detailed with delineated architectural elements, reflective of Renaissance-style interpretation of Roman architecture and everyday life.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple scenes interconnected in a narrative format. The main composition is divided into various sections, each depicting different actions. In the left panel, there are figures engaged in activities within an architectural setting. Another part shows people in prayer-like postures surrounded by arches and curtains. A figure at a window observes the outside. On the right side, a figure stands by a ledge looking at a distant city, while mythical creatures float among the clouds above. The composition includes classical architectural elements and implies a narrative with spiritual or divine themes.
